description: List the garden's succession plan — future plantings queued for a bed that haven't been sown yet (only status='planned'; done/skipped entries are omitted). Use when the user asks what's coming up next, what they've planned to plant, or wants to review their succession plan. For plantings already in the ground, use query_plantings instead.

garden.description: Garden name; defaults to the user's first garden.

name: list_planned_plantings
title: List planned plantings
